ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, SUPPRESS through the context functions since #51 (assumed): sort orders a SUPPRESS value as the smallest, last descending; the SUPPRESS comes from createIf, true for 1 or true and SUPPRESS for 0 or false, in any case, and anything else ends the run with po:CREATEIF (ADR-0006 amended, F-37; fn/createIf/002); observation #61
note: createIf over Tag in context Orders gives SUPPRESS, "", SUPPRESS, "". Descending puts SUPPRESS last: "", "", SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS. formatByExample cuts after three slots, so the first context holds two "": two empty All. Unsorted or SUPPRESS first gives one.
